text:
maya: Quick sync 5 final SEO/redirect/schema pass for Wed launch. Need owners for redirects, schema, canonicals, internal anchors, and UTM checks. Ill lock preflight once owners confirm.

omar: Ill own redirects + post-deploy 301 smoke. Plan: generate redirect_map.csv and run staging simulation. Example nginx rules Ill test:
```
rewrite ^/old-feature(/.*)?$ /feature$1 permanent;
rewrite ^/pricing-old$ /pricing permanent;
```
Ill attach CSV to OPS-4123 and request 02:00 UTC deploy window.

leigh: Ill take structured data + canonical tags. Adding WebinarEvent + FAQPage JSON-LD + speaker schema. Snippet (will paste full JSON-LD in PR):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2024-06-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}
```
Note: keep FAQ answers concise (<300 chars) and avoid duplicative Qs.

sam: Ill do internal link anchor sweep across blog/docs and update CTAs on the webinar landing (v1/v2 messaging). Priority anchors: features -> benchmarks -> pricing. Will raise PRs by EOD.

growth: Ill validate GA/UTM specs and event mappings. Confirming campaign params: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=jun24_launch. Also want a click event on CTA mapped as "webinar_register_click".

maya: Couple of questions: 1) Are we canonicalizing querystring variants to clean URLs at the CDN? 2) Who will run post-deploy crawl?

omar: CDN should strip utm on canonical or we canonicalize in-page to clean URL. Ill do post-deploy crawl with curl + simple HTML parse to assert canonical and H1. Adding crawl step to OPS runbook.

leigh: Agreed on canonical in head: <link rel="canonical" href="https://redwood.ai/webinar" />. Also will ensure schema is on staging and tag maya when ready for QA.

sam: For anchors Ill use full absolute paths without query strings. If eng needs a template tweak to preserve anchors across redirects, ping me.

maya: Checklist Im tracking:
- redirect_map.csv attached to OPS-4123 (omar)
- staging JSON-LD + canonical present (leigh)
- internal links & CTA copy updates (sam)
- GA/UTM events mapped (growth)
- post-deploy 301 & content smoke tests (omar + eng-sre)
Please reply with owner or 'ok' so I can freeze preflight doc.

omar: ok (redirects + smoke)

leigh: ok (schema + canonical)

sam: ok (internal links + CTAs)

growth: ok (UTM/events)

maya: Final copy ask: ensure hero H1 includes primary keyword "LLM inference platform" and first 150 words include "production inference". Small tweak but helps ranking.

leigh: Will confirm H1 and first paragraph on staging and post screenshots here.

omar: Crawl step will also assert H1 text present and canonical equals clean URL.

sam: Making the copy tweak in content PR now. Will coordinate if any headline collisions.

launchbot: deploy-scheduler: New deploy request OPS-4123 scheduled by @omar for 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC.

maya: Thanks all 5 if nothing else Ill close preflight at 08:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
